modmenu.summaryTranslation.brilliant-ser: Client companion for the Brilliant server: Discord Rich Presence, announcements and wiki, chat menu, channel tabs, PM window, automation scripts and more.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.brilliant:
The official client companion for the Brilliant server (brilliantw.net).

• Discord Rich Presence with sub-server and play time
• Searchable chat menu: announcements, articles, chat history, quick messages, custom commands
• Channel tabs and a private message window
• Scratch-style automation scripts with a template library
• Command aliases and TAB completion
• Emoji picker, color preview, HD image viewer, recipe book fix
• In-game update notices

Only active on brilliantw.net.
